title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Solo #09 (MoroccanZellige+KoreanEunipsa+ItalianDeruta+EthiopianCrossLattice)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, cool and composed, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates one zone. Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands, dense lattice fills) dominates the second zone. Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands, dense repeating floral border) dominates the third zone. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Footwear: extreme platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
